== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Imperial Justice (Japanese)|Imperial Justice]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=67784 Japanese A New Hope source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(24, 13, 463, 620)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>6c6adafbc8bbe43620b6350ba29402652a5c887253383da124604268c557dc33</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-8/87/Japanese-ANH-Imperial-Justice-SWCA-67784.jpg Internet Archive item].
